_comment: Microsoft Fabric MCP server (@microsoft/fabric-mcp, github.com/microsoft/mcp) — Copilot CLI format. The server authenticates via DefaultAzureCredential (your 'az login' session) and does NOT read FABRIC_AUTH_TOKEN. Run 'az login' with at least the Contributor workspace role before launching the CLI. IMPORTANT for multi-tenant Microsoft identities: AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS=AzureCliCredential + AZURE_TENANT_ID pin auth to your 'az login' session and Fabric tenant — without them, DefaultAzureCredential's interactive-browser fallback signs in to your HOME tenant and you'll see the wrong workspaces (or 404s). Remove AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS if you intend to use a managed identity / service principal instead of az login. FABRIC_AUTH_TOKEN is optional and only used for the pre-flight curl smoke-test in labs/lab12.md; FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID/FABRIC_TENANT_ID are informational. See labs/lab12.md for the full setup walkthrough and the offline simulator fallback.

fabric.description: Microsoft Fabric MCP — enumerate workspaces/lakehouses/tables and query OneLake from Copilot CLI. Authenticates via your 'az login' session (DefaultAzureCredential).

auth.smoke_test_token_command: az account get-access-token --resource https://api.fabric.microsoft.com --query accessToken -o tsv
auth.warning: NEVER paste a token into this file. The server uses your az login session; the smoke-test token is only for a manual curl check.
